prompts.label: Part A · 第 51 题
prompts.prompt: Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organize a team for the international innovation contest to be held at your university. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the email; use “Li Ming” instead.

prompts.label: Part B · 第 52 题
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should 1) describe the picture briefly, 2) interpret the implied meaning, and 3) give your comments. Write your answer on the ANSWER SHEET.
